annotations.title: See a place on the GlobeNow 3D globe

description: Use when the user asks what is happening in a city or place (e.g. 'news from Tokyo', '台北发生了什么'). Returns the latest news videos filmed or reported there (default: last 24 hours) with outlets, coordinates and links to the city page and the 3D globe. In clients that support MCP Apps it shows a place card (city photo from Wikimedia, place name) with one button that opens the full GlobeNow.tv 3D globe at that place in a new tab, where the user drags the globe and taps a light to play that video.

language.description: Language for titles and links: en (default), zh, zh-hant, ja, ko (zh-CN, zh-TW, ja-JP… also accepted)
